note: Pad under the band is all green (6 of 6) after two rounds at 66 bpm. Chord changes are almost exactly on the beat. The left-over notes were brushes: soft (velocity 27–59) and 10–80 ms after the beat, as your hand moved over an old key. They went from about 12% to 3%. Next on the path to smooth shapes: Two-Hand 1 → 2 and Pattern 5 unlock Two-Hand 7 (smooth changes), which unlocks the smooth-shapes pad. Earlier results: E, D/Dm and Em are your slowest chords, and B♭/E♭ in G minor.

items.title: Two-Hand Trainer · 1 · Together
items.why: Both hands landing at the same instant. Quick, and it unlocks level 2 (right holds, left steady).

items.title: Pattern Trainer · 5 · Open 5th
items.why: With Two-Hand 2, it unlocks Two-Hand 7 (smooth changes) and the Right-Hand Trainer.

items.title: Kumzitz Jam · Pad, +4 bpm
items.why: Green at 66 bpm. Try 70 and keep the brushes away: lift the fingers straight up before moving.
